This [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''[[Controller/Legends|controller]]''' served aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] circa [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]]. From aboard the ''Executor'', he monitored incoming traffic through the Imperial [[Skirmish on Shelkonwa|blockade]] of [[Shelkonwa]].
